decisions.reason: Turnaround management is central to the firm's data-driven airport operations strategy and has a dedicated web presence, so it is a core software offering.
Apron connectivity enables the integrated platform, though after dropping the apron resource module it may be folded into a broader suite.
Billing software sits further from the operational core but brings recurring revenue and ties in with turnaround data, so it is kept for now.
Equipment monitoring uses the installed hardware base and supports the growing maintenance and service business.
The controller safety alert service fits the firm's tower and surface movement expertise, and safety products tend to have long lifecycles.
